Goomy

Dragon

Kalos · Generation 6

Goomy is a Dragon-type Soft Tissue Pokémon first found in Kalos (Generation 6). It stands 0.3 m tall and weighs 2.8 kg. It evolves into Sliggoo. Its highest base stat is Sp. Def (75), with a base stat total of 300.
